caption: The video showcases a vertical rectangular brick column centered against a pure black background, with orange flames active across its front face. A thin, wavy flame trail runs down the brick surface, continuously morphing and shifting laterally rather than translating as a rigid shape, changing thickness and brightness frame to frame. Above the top edge, a larger flickering plume rises and deforms, sometimes tall and branching, sometimes curling into an arc, yet it persists without appearing or vanishing. Two short flame tongues sit at the bottom, flickering in height and intensity while remaining present. The brick column stays fixed in position and size throughout. The viewpoint holds steady, with the bricks and black background remaining stationary. The visible motion is confined to the flame shapes, which undulate and pulse against the unchanging masonry, the fire still burning.
